content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6 to 2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight each day. That range has solid research support for muscle growth. For example, at 75 kg you'd eat roughly 120 to 165 g. 💪

Spread it over 3 to 5 meals, with about 20 to 40 g each. Eating more than 2.2 g/kg won't add much. Since you're chasing a 100 kg bench, make sure you also get enough total calories.
